question: How many repeat customers were there in January–June 2025 and in July–December 2025? Evaluate repeat status separately within each reporting period, then say which half had more.

action.query:
SELECT reporting_period, COUNT(DISTINCT CUSTOMER_ID) AS repeat_customer_count
FROM (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID,
           CASE WHEN ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2025-07-01' THEN 'H1 2025'
                WHEN ORDER_DATE >= '2025-07-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01' THEN 'H2 2025' END AS reporting_period
    FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER
    WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID, reporting_period
    HAVING COUNT(ORDER_ID) > 1
) t
GROUP BY reporting_period
ORDER BY reporting_period;

action.answer: In January–June 2025 (H1 2025), there were 95,048 repeat customers (customers who placed more than one order within that half-year). In July–December 2025 (H2 2025), there were 96,514 repeat customers (again, evaluated only within that half-year). H2 2025 had more repeat customers than H1 2025. Population: all customers with more than one order in each respective half of 2025. Unit: unique customers per half-year. Interpretation: Customer repeat activity was slightly higher in the second half of 2025.
